'''John Shields Hunt Down Inserts''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[John Shields]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds87.htm Hunt Down Inserts], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001029103550/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds87.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
